name: Chicken Pizza Pockets with Roast Potato Wedges

components.name: Chicken Pizza Pockets

ingredients.name: Olive oil spray equivalent for lining pan

steps: Mix ground chicken with garlic powder, dried herbs, salt and pepper; portion into four equal raw mounds.
On separate pieces of baking parchment, flatten each portion into an even oval approximately 1 cm thick.
Spread passata across half of each oval, then add a quarter of the mozzarella; fold the other side of the chicken over and press edges closed.
Top with parmesan and a tiny amount of olive oil. Transfer carefully to a hot oven tray and bake until golden and chicken is at least 74 C throughout, about 20-25 minutes depending on thickness.

components.name: Roast Potato Wedges

ingredients.name: Raw potatoes, scrubbed and cut into wedges

steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Toss potato wedges with their oil, paprika and salt, and roast in a single layer around 30-40 minutes, turning once.
Keep the potato side separate if you want to crisp wedges again during reheating.

components.name: Green Vegetables

ingredients.name: Raw green beans or broccoli florets

steps: Roast or steam broccoli/green beans until just tender and portion with cooked pockets and potato wedges.

Original viral Bikini Bod Pizza Pocket is a LOW-CARB chicken-filled pocket, credited by Hadrian to @madelainerascan. UNHANGRY includes weighed potato and vegetable sides to qualify as a full meal; do NOT reuse original pocket-only creator macros.
Planning: Chicken pocket is made from RAW ground chicken (no pizza dough). Source post gives approx 455 kcal per pocket BEFORE our side dishes; cooked yield estimated.
Freezer: frozen cooked pockets are feasible, coating softens; potato wedges lose crispness
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
